title: Prometheus Global Operations
objective: Keep the cross-phase processes that should outlive every numbered phase: the evidence refinery, fleet observability, coordination infrastructure, durable scientific registries, the reusable failure corpus, and (potentially) shared resource brokerage.
scope: Forever processes. Not a parent of the numbered phase epics: EP-GLOBAL, EP-PHASE2B and EP-PHASE3 are peers.
start_date: existing program history (declared as an epic 2026-10-03)
constraints: Evidence rolls upward; interpretive authority does not: a claim stays attached to the exact cells/evidence that earned it; no epic or thread name lends its interpretation to a child (roles/base-role/DISTRIBUTED_WORK.md s1a)
Base-role doctrine and current MWO/CWO hard gates apply unchanged
Processes here serve every epic; they do not take scientific ownership of another epic's claims
exit_conditions: None: permanent. Individual campaigns inside its threads close; the epic and its threads persist.
operator_decisions: 2026-10-03 EP-GLOBAL declared permanent; peer of the phase epics (roles/Achilles/prompts/2026-10-03_epics_phase2b/01_OPERATOR_DIRECTIVE_verbatim.md)
2026-10-03 generic workers, epic priority bands, operator priority queue placed under EP-GLOBAL / TH-GLOBAL-CONTROL-PLANE (roles/Achilles/prompts/2026-10-03_generic_workers/)
exclusions: Phase-specific science and engineering (they belong to EP-PHASE2B / EP-PHASE3 and later phases)
